text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe lets out a small sigh. She 
seems rather downcast...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I had ordered specialty coffee, but... 
they contacted me to say it's going to be 
significantly delayed...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She must have been deeply disheartened, as 
Manhattan Cafe seemed out of sorts for the 
rest of the day...
